reason: Both proposals rely on the questionable formation of alumina at a buried Cr–Zr interface despite oxygen entering from the coating surface, but A has the more decisive falsification rule because it separately tests interdiffusion suppression and preservation of subcritical-water performance. B is more numerically specific, yet its cited HEA/Hf-coating studies do not support Al-induced interfacial alumina in Cr-coated zirconium, and its falsification rule conflates oxidation weight gain with interdiffusion.
